passage.label: O believed when believing women come as emigrants examine them, Allah most knowing of their faith; if you know them believers do not return them to disbelievers, they are not lawful wives for them nor lawful husbands; give the disbelievers what they spent; no blame if you marry them having given due compensation; hold not marriage bonds with disbelieving women but ask what you spent and let them ask what they spent; that is the judgement of Allah He judges between you, Knowing Wise; if you lost wives to disbelievers and subsequently obtain something give those whose wives gone the equivalent of what they spent, fear Allah in whom you believe; O Prophet when believing women come pledging not to associate anything with Allah nor steal nor commit unlawful sexual intercourse nor kill their children nor bring forth invented slander nor disobey you in what is right, accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them, Forgiving Merciful; O believed do not make allies of a people Allah angry with, they despaired of the Hereafter as disbelievers despaired of meeting the inhabitants of the graves

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا جَآءَكُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتُ مُهَٰجِرَٰتٖ فَٱمۡتَحِنُوهُنَّۖ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِإِيمَٰنِهِنَّۖ فَإِنۡ عَلِمۡتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤۡمِنَٰتٖ فَلَا تَرۡجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِۖ لَا هُنَّ حِلّٞ لَّهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مَّآ أَنفَقُواْۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَآ ءَاتَيۡتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّۚ وَلَا تُمۡسِكُواْ بِعِصَمِ ٱلۡكَوَافِرِ وَسۡـَٔلُواْ مَآ أَنفَقۡتُمۡ وَلۡيَسۡـَٔلُواْ مَآ أَنفَقُواْۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ حُكۡمُ ٱللَّهِ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡۖ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ
وَإِن فَاتَكُمۡ شَيۡءٞ مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبۡتُمۡ فَـَٔاتُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتۡ أَزۡوَٰجُهُم مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنفَقُواْۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنُونَ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتُ يُبَايِعۡنَكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن لَّا يُشۡرِكۡنَ بِٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَسۡرِقۡنَ وَلَا يَزۡنِينَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلۡنَ أَوۡلَٰدَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأۡتِينَ بِبُهۡتَٰنٖ يَفۡتَرِينَهُۥ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِنَّ وَأَرۡجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعۡصِينَكَ فِي مَعۡرُوفٖ فَبَايِعۡهُنَّ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُنَّ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ قَوۡمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَدۡ يَئِسُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡقُبُورِ

mainSubject.label: Emigrant believing women to be examined, with Allah most knowing of their faith; once recognised as believers they must not be returned to disbelievers since the marriage bond is dissolved in both directions, while the disbelievers' expenditure is reimbursed and remarriage permitted after due compensation; marriage bonds with disbelieving women not to be maintained, with mutual claims for expenditure settled as Allah's judgement under knowledge and wisdom; compensation ruled for men whose wives went over to the disbelievers, under taqwa; the Prophet instructed to accept the pledge of believing women covering six commitments — no association, no theft, no unlawful intercourse, no killing of children, no invented slander and no disobedience in what is right — then to seek forgiveness for them; closing prohibition of alliance with a people under divine anger who have despaired of the Hereafter as disbelievers despair of meeting the grave-dwellers

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the kinship-futility and Resurrection-judgement statement (3) before the Abrahamic pattern opens (4); P2 ends with the possible-affection concession (7) before the two-category justice rule begins (8); P3 covers the permitted and forbidden categories of non-believers (8-9); P4 runs from the examination of emigrant women through compensation rulings, the women's pledge and the closing alliance prohibition (10-13).
